caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, pillar-like object featuring elaborate ornamental designs. The top of the object is capped with a green, irregularly shaped band that appears to represent leaves or foliage, edged with a twisted rope-like trim. Below this is a textured, crosshatched band, followed by a section decorated with carved fruit and laurel leaves, primarily in muted yellow and green hues. The central and lower portions exhibit swirling, acanthus-like leaf patterns in shades of beige, cream, and pale yellow, with defined shadowing for depth. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or elements.
title: Mast Sheath
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
